STRATEGY REVIEW

THE BET
Shipping the migration this quarter buys the renewal conversation a working story [cite:strategy.md].

PRICE
It displaces the hydrator pilot entirely [cite:strategy.md].

STANCE: proceed
BECAUSE: the renewal window is the constraint and the displaced pilot has no date attached
CITE: strategy.md

DESIGN REVIEW

BOUNDARIES
The migration moves the promotion boundary into the deploy path [cite:rfc-002-manifest-hydrator.md].

REVERSIBILITY
Once stage branches carry promoted manifests there is no recorded path back [cite:rfc-002-manifest-hydrator.md].

STANCE: hold
BECAUSE: the boundary change is one-way and nothing records how to unwind it
CITE: rfc-002-manifest-hydrator.md

decision.question: Two concerns disagree on this outcome: migrate billing this quarter — 1 role(s) say hold, 1 say proceed. This one is yours to call.

positions.stance: proceed — the renewal window is the constraint and the displaced pilot has no date attached
hold — the boundary change is one-way and nothing records how to unwind it

the reversible default if you do nothing: this holds, because holding can be undone tomorrow and proceeding cannot. That is what silence costs, not a preference — system-design argued for it, strategy-alignment argued against, and the call is yours
